title: Corporate Hierarchy Archive
description: Design an algorithm to encode a company's organizational reporting structure tree into a single string format and decode that string back into the exact same tree structure. The structure is a standard binary tree where each node represents an employee with an integer ID, and nodes can be null if no employee exists at that position.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4].
input_format: The root of a binary tree.
output_format: A serialized string representation or the root of the deserialized binary tree.

examples.explanation: The tree structure is preserved after a serialization and subsequent deserialization cycle.
An empty tree serializes to an empty array representation.
A single node tree remains a single node tree.
